editorial:
A. and your life looks perfect on paper, but then everything crashes down when your son is kidnapped. You and your wife only have a few hours to find a huge amount of cash, but there is one big problem: you spent all your money on the campaign. This movie puts you right in the middle of that panic. You get to see these high-society people lose their cool and do things they never thought they would just to save their kid. It feels like a race against the clock that keeps you on the edge of your seat from the very start.

Ben Affleck does a great job directing the action, and the acting feels very real. The best part is seeing the main couple slowly turn into criminals just to survive the night. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the energy never drops. It is a wild ride that anyone who loves a good crime story will enjoy.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the kidnapping was actually a setup by the candidate's own campaign manager to make him look like a hero. The manager wanted to control him by holding the secret over his head. After a big fight, the parents rescue their son and turn the manager over to the police. They decide to drop out of the race and leave politics behind, choosing their family over power and fame.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-stakes thrillers and crime dramas.
